Using HDMI connection for models with HDMI ports Connecting a camcorder Small camcorders commonly used at home are equipped with a mini HDMI port, allowing you to connect them to a TV.
This feature proves particularly useful when using the TV screen in place of the viewfinder during shooting or when viewing previously recorded images.
By connecting a camcorder with a mini HDMI port to an HD TV, you can enjoy the recordings on your TV in HD picture quality.
Connecting a DSLR camera If your DSLR camera supports HD recording, you can also enjoy the recordings on your TV in HD picture quality.
Note Since small-sized devices like camcorders and digital cameras are typically equipped with a mini HDMI port, a regular HDMI cable cannot be used for connectivity.
Instead, you will need an HDMI-to-mini HDMI cable to connect these devices to your TV.

This water-free drying system involves discharging steam through the drain hose and into the sewer system.
If some amount of water remains in the drain hose due to incomplete water drainage, steam cannot be expelled.
This may result in tapping or grinding noises as well as poor drying performance.
For effective drying performance, an uninterrupted flow of steam through the drain hose needs to be ensured, and water must not accumulate inside the hose.
This can be achieved by gently lowering the drain hose, ensuring it does not form a U-shape (U-trap).
Note The water-free drying system uses a small amount of water to prevent accumulation of dust in the internal components, so please leave the faucet open.
General drying system Washer/dryer combos use a small amount of water for drying.
Overloading the unit may result in degraded drying performance.
When drying thick clothes, folded parts may not dry well.
Try this Water-free drying system Make sure the drain hose descends smoothly to the floor without any bends.
The drying capacity is smaller than the washing capacity.
When connecting the drain hose to the drain hole, the hose should lie flat on the ground so that a U-trap does not form.

Troubleshooting Cooking Appliances 07/16/2026 Print Email Copy Link Share If food odors remain inside your LG microwave, you can use the deodorization function to keep the 'inside the microwave fresh.
When is the best time to use the deodorization function?
How to use the deodorization function to remove odors inside the microwave Causes of odors inside the microwave 1.
After cooking food with strong odors, the smell may linger inside the oven cavity.
Food scraps or spills during cooking can cause persistent odors.
How to use the deodorization function 1.
Before running the deodorization function, empty the microwave completely, removing all food and dishes.
For models with a [Deodorize] button on the control panel, press the button to automatically run the function for 5 minutes.
We recommend wiping the interior walls and ceiling clean with a damp dishcloth or soft sponge, then running the deodorization function again.

Why Does Error Code CH03 or CH04 Appear?
Your air conditioner displays an error code when its self-diagnostic system detects a problem.
Error code CH03 indicates a wired remote control problem caused by a faulty remote, wiring issues, or a main circuit board error.
Error code CH04 indicates a drainage problem caused by a malfunctioning drain pump, a blocked or upward-sloping drain hose, or a dirty filter.

Troubleshooting Laundry Accessories, Washers 04/14/2026 Print Email Copy Link Share If the water doesn't seem to reach the selected temperature during a wash, don't worry—your machine is operating normally.
Cold Water Supply If the incoming tap water is colder than average room temperature (around 20–25°C / 68–77°F), the machine naturally requires more time to heat the water.
If your model features a Normal 40°C or Normal 60°C cycle, selecting one of these can help optimize the water temperature.
LG washers are designed to optimize energy efficiency and prevent high electricity bills.
Why the water may not reach the set temperature Common Reasons 1.
Energy Saving System To prevent unusually high energy consumption from prolonged heating, your washer features a built-in timer.
If heating takes too long, the machine will automatically proceed to the next phase of the wash cycle to save energy, even if the exact target temperature hasn't been fully reached.
Helpful Tips 1.
Rest assured, your washer is operating normally.
This is a built-in feature designed to save energy, so you can continue using your machine without any worries.
However, keep in mind that heating the water will take longer, and the machine may proceed to the next phase of the wash cycle before fully reaching your selected temperature.
To speed up the wash cycle, make sure the hot water hose is properly connected to a hot water tap and the valve is fully open.
